decisions.decision: One Neuvetra GHG brand; FrontDesk deferred
Rebuild answer and calculation trust boundaries
decisions.why: Legacy citation and numerical code cannot establish supported and reproducible outputs

decisions.decision: Raw downloads require review before runtime release
decisions.why: Integrity, authority, effective date and method applicability are different checks

decisions.decision: Relevant specialist delegation and independent QA with CEO roll-up
decisions.why: Clear ownership, evidence and brief board reports without fabricated agent activity

decisions.decision: Keep the green palette and simple presentation; close M1 feedback gate
decisions.why: User reviewed both preview pages and approved this direction

decisions.decision: Refresh and verify source versions before releasing answer evidence
decisions.why: Board's concern about inherited data freshness; publisher corrections and incomplete prior synthesis confirmed the need

decisions.decision: Start the answer demonstration with purchased-electricity/Scope 2 research
decisions.why: A bounded question family makes passage support, context requests and refusal behavior reviewable before broader legal and industry coverage

decisions.decision: Disable optional automatic Claude Code Review; retain Verify and independent agent review
decisions.why: Board authorization; the PR integration failed before review because no usable Anthropic credential was supplied, while both Verify jobs passed

decisions.decision: Model selects locked reviewed propositions for the first answer pilot
decisions.why: A real model interprets bounded questions while server-controlled text and exact citations make claim support independently testable

decisions.decision: Keep the first evidence release private and scoped to reviewed EPA concepts
decisions.why: Source support, current status and commercial rights require distinct review; GHG Protocol material has reuse restrictions and a correction-date discrepancy

decisions.decision: Version the reporting explanation and require complete compound-question support
decisions.why: Board feedback exposed missing reporting coverage. Method definitions, reporting recommendation and reporting rationale are separate reviewed concepts; a recommendation must retain its qualification

decisions.decision: Replace the vocabulary-gated fixed-statement path with a separately reviewed passage experiment
decisions.why: The second board question is rejected before retrieval; five fixed statements cannot answer the supporting document. Evaluate semantic paragraph selection and independent completeness checks across question families.

decisions.decision: Hold the dynamic answer release and retain all failed experiments
decisions.why: Source and software integrity pass, but live drafting and verification still miss conditions or withhold useful answers. A stronger drafting model did not pass the observed gate. Bounded correction and false-approval detection need separate evidence, not question-specific rules.

decisions.decision: Use cloud Pinecone and Supabase for development integration; stop local container setup
decisions.why: Board chose cloud after local prerequisite friction. Isolate development data and preserve verified release boundaries; cloud connectivity is distinct from answer accuracy.

decisions.decision: Verify cloud storage and citation primitives with six owned fictional passages before transferring reviewed source material
decisions.why: A tiny fixed fixture tests the actual data path, access controls and integrity without implying semantic accuracy, source approval or successful dynamic answering. Credentials, source review and activation remain separate server responsibilities.

decisions.decision: Integrate a separately reviewed EPA corpus into the existing private cloud resources and test the actual website before local promotion
decisions.why: Board approved a third private reader and EPA workspace. Shared cloud connectivity is verified; useful claim-complete answers require independent quality evidence. Keep source bounds, one correction attempt and durable shared provider counters.

decisions.decision: Require a source-reviewed condition ledger for every answer paragraph and preserve interrupted evaluation attempts
decisions.why: An actual verifier false approval omitted a material prerequisite. Mandatory conditions improve review coverage but still require independent semantic QA. Runtime loss must not erase usage or uncertain outcomes.

decisions.decision: Render immutable independently reviewed explanation units and assess whole-question fit separately
decisions.why: Generated prose introduced unsupported causal wording despite model review; fixed source-supported wording bounds that risk while semantic selection remains tested.

decisions.decision: Treat local website operation, answer quality and browser demonstration as separate release gates
decisions.why: The website targeted a stopped answering service while a separate candidate was live; actual browser submissions and independent verification now close that gap.
